Nina hopes to visit Toronto one day. Nina thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Nina plays football with David every Friday. I borrow books from the library every week.
Nina wrote about the day in the diary. They took many photos at the library desk. The weather was cloudy that day. It was merely a cold, so don't worry.
There are always many people at the library desk. Nina and David had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. In fact, my daughter studies law at Exeter University.
